content.full_text: HTW Berlin - University of Applied Sciences - studies, research, further education Organisational units Central Administrative Departments Student Services Student Service Centre Student Service Centre The Student Service Centre is the central point of contact for applicants, students and alumni. Here, questions and concerns are answered directly or forwarded to the appropriate departments. Our responsibilities in detail Providing information and coordinating and forwarding enquiries and applications Processing de-registrations Replacement HTW Student Card Issuing replacement documents, e.g. university semester, enrolment and de-registration certificates Certification of documents Clarification of questions regarding the Germany semester ticket Contact form The best way to contact us is via our contact form . Please note: For certificates and authentications , please use this form exclusively. Kindly note that on Thursday, January 15, 2026 , personal consultation hours at both campus locations will be offered exclusively in the morning. The afternoon office hours (12:30–3:00 p.m.) are cancelled on this date. Office hours Wilhelminenhof Campus Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday: 9:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. and 1:00 p.m. to 3:00 p.m. Building G, Room 125a (glass box opposite the library) Treskowallee Campus Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday: 9:00 a.m. – 11:30 a.m. and 12:30 p.m. to 3:00 p.m. Building A, Room 040 Telephone hotline +49 30 5019 - 2919 Monday and Friday 9:00–11:30 a.m. Postal address Hochschule für Technik und Wirtschaft Berlin Studierenden-Service-Center Treskowallee 8 10318 Berlin
